newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on commission, export demand.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on commission, export demand.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on commission house and export demand, traders said.

"Crushers bought early on a lower market but they didn't chase it up, locals turned buyers by midday, Cargill liquidated its long position in July," a trader said. March futures crush profit margin fell to -26.33 from -25.41 Tuesday on CBOT soy oil, meal. Mar-May spread at $0.50, Mar-July $1.70, Sep-Nov $5, Mar-July $1.70. Volume was 4,550 lots, or 91,000 tonnes, with 300 hedges.
Japan bought 3,000-4,000 tonnes overnight, sources said. Mexico was rumoured to be seeking canola.
March canola rose $2.30 to $404.40, May up $1.70 to $404.20. March flax rose $1.70 to $344.70 on hedges met by local short covering. Oats did not trade.

February western barley rose $0.30 to $139 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold to PCTS, March rose $0.90 to $137.70 as commission houses covered shorts, traders said. Mar-May spread at $1, Feb May $3. Volume was 1,200 lots.

March feed wheat rose $0.70 to $169.60 with LFG a late seller, May up $0.30 at $165.60. Mar-May spread at $3.80, Mar-July $8, Mar-Dec $15.50. Volume was 745 lots. UGG bought 50 May feed peas from commercials, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats and peas.)
